notes.testing: TSR (kingdoms/tsr, typed_depth Some(2)) on feynman_I_15_10, the relativistic momentum law m0*v/sqrt(1-v^2/c^2), depth 1. Sampler typed in init AND point mutation; span-moving operators left to the decode; write_back refuses a graft that breaks the ceiling. No control arm -- the untyped engine's numbers at these settings are on the record and cited, not re-run.
notes.outcome: LAW RECOVERED IN ITS TRUE FORM at generation 1,001 of 1,001, by early_stop: ((x_0*x_1)/sqrt((1.0 - ((x_1/x_2)**2)))) -- exactly m0*v/sqrt(1-(v/c)^2). train 1-R2 1.158e-13, validation 1.056e-13, log10 p -33.54, test R2 1.000000. 111.5 ms/generation at 800+400 over 75,000 rows. 105,697 genes refused on type = 2.93% of gene-slots per generation; 0 refused as oversized. Final depth histogram 0:2221 1:1107 2:239 3:19 4:10 5:3 6:1 -- THE T2 CEILING BINDS AND IS NOT VACUOUS (239 genes sit exactly at it) and only 0.9% of genes are past it, those being refused genes riding along unscored in a 3-gene chromosome. The recovered law is itself depth 1, well inside the ceiling.

notes.testing: MATCHED CHECK added after the sweep: the same binary, seed and 180 s budget run with typed_depth UNSET, to see whether this recovery is a TSR result or something the engine does anyway.
notes.outcome: IT IS A TSR RESULT, on this seed. Untyped at seed 7014, 180 s: NOT recovered, 1,120 generations, train 1-R2 1.533e-7, and it reports tan(tan(log(1/cos(x_1/x_2)))) -- a DEPTH-4 TOWER, the exact shape TSR makes unrepresentable. TSR at the same seed recovered the law itself at train 1-R2 1.158e-13. One seed only: seed 7015 did not recover it under TSR either, so by the record's two-seed rule this is not yet a kept result.
